body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. The target reduces its next incoming Psychic or Arcane Damage by 2 until the start of your next turn; it knows the direction of that effect's source after resolution.

surges.html: Extend the protection to Radiant or Necrotic Damage as well.
Also suppress one ordinary sensory impairment on the target until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Strain - Barrier
rider.html: If you accepted Strain, leave a mental landmark in the target's space: you ignore ordinary concealment when targeting that space with Psionics until the start of your next turn.
